Releasing banditlab 0.1.0

Source: RELEASE.md

Status when this folder was prepared (Ubuntu, R 4.3.3, ggplot2 3.4.4):

  • R CMD check --as-cran: Status: OK (0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes)
  • Spelling (spelling::spell_check_package()): no errors (en-GB, inst/WORDLIST)
  • pkgdown site: builds fully, including the NR link-adaptation article

Not tested there (no internet access to CRAN, no LaTeX): URL checks, the PDF manual, and ggplot2 >= 3.5.0. Steps 4 and 5 cover these.

1. Put the code on GitHub

If RProDigest/banditlab already exists, apply this folder on a branch so you can review the diff before merging:

git clone https://github.com/RProDigest/banditlab.git
cd banditlab
git checkout -b release-0.1.0
rsync -av --exclude .git /path/to/this/banditlab/ ./
git status && git diff          # review: anything deleted that you want to keep?
git add -A
git commit -m "Prepare 0.1.0: ggplot2 compatibility fix, CI, pkgdown, NR article"
git push -u origin release-0.1.0

Open a pull request, wait for the R-CMD-check workflow to pass on all five platforms, then merge to main.

If the repository does not exist yet:

cd /path/to/this/banditlab
git init -b main && git add -A && git commit -m "banditlab 0.1.0"
gh repo create RProDigest/banditlab --public --source=. --push

2. Turn on the pkgdown website

The pkgdown workflow builds the site on every push to main and pushes it to a gh-pages branch. After its first successful run:

GitHub repo -> Settings -> Pages -> Build and deployment -> Source: “Deploy from a branch” -> Branch: gh-pages, folder / (root) -> Save.

The site appears at https://rprodigest.github.io/banditlab/. The URL is already in DESCRIPTION, _pkgdown.yml and the README badge.

(Alternative, from R in the repo: usethis::use_pkgdown_github_pages() does the same setup.)

The NR article (vignettes/articles/) is website-only: it takes about 4 minutes to run, so it is excluded from the CRAN build.

3. Check CI is green

GitHub repo -> Actions. Both R-CMD-check and pkgdown should pass. If ggplot2 >= 3.5.0 causes any problem, it will show up here.

4. Final local checks (on your machine, with internet and LaTeX)

devtools::document()        # roxygen2: should change nothing
devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE)   # adds URL + PDF manual checks
urlchecker::url_check()     # optional: fixes redirected URLs

Expected: one NOTE, “New submission”. Anything else, fix before step 5.

5. Check on CRAN’s own builders

devtools::check_win_devel()   # emails results to the maintainer address
rhub::rhub_setup()            # once; adds an rhub workflow to the repo
rhub::rhub_check()            # runs on GitHub Actions

Then edit cran-comments.md so it states the results you actually got (it currently lists the planned environments).

6. Submit

devtools::submit_cran()

CRAN sends a confirmation link to RProDigest@protonmail.com (the Maintainer in DESCRIPTION). Click it, or the submission is not processed. Make sure that inbox is one you check: all CRAN correspondence goes there.

After submitting, a CRAN-SUBMISSION file appears; it is already in .Rbuildignore. Commit it.

7. If the reviewer asks for changes

First submissions are usually reviewed by a person. Reply by resubmitting with the fixes and a short note at the top of cran-comments.md (“This is a resubmission. In this version I have: …”). Bump nothing unless asked.

8. After acceptance

git tag v0.1.0 && git push --tags
gh release create v0.1.0 --title "banditlab 0.1.0" --notes-file NEWS.md

Then add “(development version)” at the top of NEWS.md and bump Version: to 0.1.0.9000 for ongoing work.
